scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test:unit && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.verify:clean: git diff --exit-code && git diff --cached --exit-code && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const out=execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(out){console.error('Repository not clean');console.error(out);process.exit(1);}console.log('Repository clean');"
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run verify:clean
